name: ISS cabin atmosphere
source: Nominal 14.7 psia (101.3 kPa), 21% O2: NASA NTRS 20070021378 (Lange et al., historical spacecraft atmospheres). Range = nominal +/-0.2 psia and +/-2% O2, tolerance from the same document's Constellation table (project assumption). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20070021378/downloads/20070021378.pdf

name: NASA exploration atmosphere (8.2 psia, 34% O2)
source: Nominal 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa), 34% O2: NASA NTRS 20140000417. Range = nominal +/-0.2 psia and +/-2% O2, tolerance borrowed from NTRS 20070021378 (project assumption). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20140000417/downloads/20140000417.pdf

name: Reduced-pressure staged cabin (10.2 psia, 26.5% O2)
source: Nominal 10.2 psia (70.3 kPa), 26.5% O2: NASA NTRS 20070021378 and NTRS 20200002346. Range = nominal +/-0.2 psia and +/-2% O2, tolerance from NTRS 20070021378 (project assumption). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20070021378/downloads/20070021378.pdf

name: Spacesuit (4.3 psia, pure O2)
source: 4.3 psia (29.6 kPa), 100% O2, capability range 4.0-4.6 psia: NASA NTRS 20070021378 (Constellation summary). O2 range = 100% -2% (project assumption). https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20070021378/downloads/20070021378.pdf
